item.tib: bsam lhun sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyong nyams len bar chad kun sel dge bsam lhun grub yid nor 'dren pa'i shing rta
item.coloph: ces bsags sbyong rim pa rgyud dang sgrub thabs la brten nas mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs kyi gsung dri med byin rlabs che ba'i kha skong nas bsgrigs pa/ bsam lhun lung mthun smin slob gter chen brgya rtsa'i nang nas ngu za rigs gtogs dbon po tshe dbang rig dang / bsam lhun sgrub pa'i skal ba can slob bu grwa btsun 'chi med dang / lung zin zhwa dkar 'chang ba'i skyes bu dbal sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin sogs slob brgyud du mas snga phyi yang yang bskul ngor tshe dbang 'gyur med nas lug lo'i zla 1tshes 1u0f8bnyin bris pas/ thog mar gu ge pa ni smin slob gral mthar slob 'bangs du gtogs pa'i ge khod dbang rgyal bdag gis byas pa'i 'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgrol ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
